items.title: Trump targets Chevron, Exxon over profits, demands lower gasoline prices
items.summary: Investing.com -- President Donald Trump on Monday stepped up his criticism of major U.S. oil companies, saying Chevron and Exxon Mobil are "making too much money" and should return some of their windfall profits to consumers by cutting gasoline prices.
